title: fix(muya): ignore a table tool click once its table left the document (#5442)
issueTitle: [Bug] Table row/column tools throw after Undo removes the table they point at
why: The report gives no visible positive result for the fixed build: the document stays the same either way, the only difference is a native "Unexpected error" dialog that the test agent cannot see, and it does not say whether the fixed app closes the menu or ignores the click.
